Figure 45 Leader Board Front-end Sequence Diagram 
The front-end sequence diagram can be divided into four segments. First, they 
system will generate a series of splash screen depending on the users’ state: (1) 
has the user ever competed, (2) is the user currently competition, (3) has the 
users rank changed since they last competed. Finally, once the user has decided 
to compete, they will see all the users in the leaderboard, and where they place.
